consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 22 November 2023 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
